payload.title: Skill sync entry points fail: top-level await under tsx's CJS transform
payload.description: `papyrus-app alexa-sync` spawns `tsx amplify/plugins/alexa/sync/cli.ts`, and `scripts/alexa/ask-deploy.ts` runs the same code; both use top-level await. tsx compiles them as CJS and fails with 'Top-level await is currently not supported with the cjs output format', found running the sync by hand on 2026-10-31. Make the entry points `.mts` or wrap them in an async main, and add a test that runs the real entry point (not only runCli) against fake ports.
